a_before_b.rationale: Instruction-following evaluation is a specific application of evaluation methodology, while defining evaluation methods and data is a broader foundational skill; mastering the specific case is not required to understand how to select methods and annotate data in general.

b_before_a.rationale: Defining general evaluation methods and data is not strictly required to understand instruction-following evaluation, as one can learn rubric-based scoring for instruction adherence without first mastering data slicing and production slice representation.
